name: security-api-batch-transaction-integrity-review
intent: Atomic security invariants across composed API operations
artifacts: Batch execution order, database transaction boundaries, compensation logic and final resource state.
trace: Identify a policy that must remain true across operations and whether an early permitted mutation persists when a later prerequisite fails.
experiment: Use a small local synthetic batch with a deliberate second-step denial and inspect final state, alongside a legitimate successful batch.
disproof: A documented partial-success API is not automatically broken; establish the intended all-or-nothing security invariant.
repair: Align transaction/compensation behavior with the invariant and retest failures at each material boundary.
branch_decisions: Write the exact invariant crossing the transaction before constructing the fixture. A documented best-effort API does not imply financial atomicity, and a transaction rollback does not undo external side effects automatically. Inspect database and external stub state separately when the operation spans both.
